entries.title: LobsterAI 2026.11.16
entries.note: What's Changed This release brings message editing with version history, inline read-aloud, full-text task search, and selectable context windows up to 1M tokens — plus a faster startup and a smoother desktop companion experience. ✨ Highlights Edit your messages, switch between versions. Rework any prompt and browse alternate versions of a turn, including turns the gateway never recorded. ( #3051 , #3086 ) Read replies aloud. Completed replies now have an inline read-aloud control. ( #3045 ) Search across your tasks. Find conversations by content with the new task search. ( #3073 ) Context windows up to 1M tokens. Explicitly choose the context window for supported models. ( #3059 ) Expert Plaza is live. Discover and summon experts from the new entry points. ( #3032 ) Faster startup. Large tool catalogs are deferred behind Tool Search, and gateway startup was trimmed. ( #3029 , #3066 ) 🚀

entries.title: LobsterAI 2026.11.6
entries.note: 2026.11.2 A release focused on reliability: chat streams now survive mid-reply drops, oversized contexts recover with visible compaction progress, the image pipeline is cheaper and less chatty, and installers ship a lot less dead weight. Highlights Model streams reconnect automatically when they drop mid-reply instead of leaving the message truncated ( #2974 ). Oversized conversations now recover instead of failing, with compaction progress surfaced in the UI ( #2982 , #3014 , #2988 ). One image confirmation can now approve the rest of a turn's images, and delivery recovery is more robust ( #2995 , #2980 , #2994 ). Installer and runtime bundles are significantly slimmer: no source maps, no tsc output, no debug-only files ( #2976 , #2985 , #2996 ). entries.title: LobsterAI 2026.10.23
entries.note: This release brings image editing into your conversations, makes remote tools easier to connect, and gives you clearer visibility into usage. It also improves startup reliability, browser tasks, and account recovery. ✨ Highlights Edit images without leaving your conversation Annotate images with drawings, arrows, shapes, and text, or select an area and describe what you want to change. With a compatible image model, you can remove backgrounds, erase objects, and expand images to a new aspect ratio. Save annotated copies or send your edits to AI. Conversation snapshots preserve the source image, selections, and annotations so you can revisit your instructions. #2907 Connect remote tools with less setup Install remote MCP connectors from the marketplace and connect through browser-based OAuth or guided credential forms. Supporting services can now be authorized without manually copying API

entries.title: LobsterAI 2026.10.13
entries.note: What’s Changed This release introduces Office document editing, Computer Use support for macOS, and improved MCP tool management. It also brings a refreshed interface, a smoother task experience, and significant improvements to OpenClaw stability and reliability. ✨ Highlights Office Document Editing — Create and edit Word, Excel, and PowerPoint documents directly in LobsterAI, with support for manual editing, AI-assisted updates, and automatic saving. Computer Use for Mac — AI can now interact with desktop applications on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. MCP Tool Picker — Search, browse, and select which MCP tools to enable, with estimated token usage for better context management. Refreshed UI — Updated colors, layouts, agent views, and task interactions for a cleaner and more consistent experience.
